_comment: The plugins PoliPlug can host. Each one is BUNDLED into PoliPlug's own folder at build time: its .so is copied to
hosted/<id>/ and its built skin is merged into PoliPlug's skin (MPC only ever draws the skin of the plugin it loaded,
so a hosted plugin's own skin folder is never shown; the merged copy is). Paths are relative to this file.
id: stable, lowercase; saved projects refer to hosted plugins by it, so never change it once released.
plugin: the plugin's own folder (with vst/vst.json and its built vst/build/). Build that plugin first.
